newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi International seeks new financial backer.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi International seeks new financial backer.

text.p: Kiwi International Airlines said on Thursday that it had not received the financing promised by Florida's Wasatch International Corp, and that it was seeking a new financial backer.
Under a bankruptcy court agreement reached in Newark last week, Wasatch was to have deposited the first of ten $500,000 payments into Kiwi's accounts.
But as of Thursday, the Newark-based carrier had received only $100,000 from Wasatch, it said.
Kiwi spokesman Bob Kulat said Kiwi would immediately be actively seeking another backer.
"This is very disappointing. It's very bizarre. The twists and turns that this company has taken have totally confused all of us at Kiwi," Kulat said.
Wasatch officials could not be reached for comment.
Kiwi said that as a result of the failed financing, it has postponed a scheduled press conference to outline a proposal to recall some of the company's 1,200 furloughed employees.
On October 31, U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Rosemary Gambardella had given preliminary approval to the debtor-in-possession financing commitment from Wasatch.
